package WurstExportedObjects_w3b
import ObjEditingNatives
import ObjEditingCommons
import DestructableObjEditing

// Modified Table (contains all custom objects)

@compiletime function create_w3b_B000()
	new DestructableDefinition('B000', 'ATtc')
	..setName("Ashenvale Canopy Tree (Large)")
	..setMaximumScale(5.0)


@compiletime function create_w3b_B001()
	new DestructableDefinition('B001', 'ZTw3')
	..setName("Stone Wall (Dark)")
	..setVertexColorRed(50)
	..setVertexColorGreen(50)
	..setVertexColorBlue(50)


@compiletime function create_w3b_B002()
	new DestructableDefinition('B002', 'ZTw1')
	..setName("Stone Wall (Dark)")
	..setVertexColorRed(50)
	..setVertexColorGreen(50)
	..setVertexColorBlue(50)


@compiletime function create_w3b_B003()
	new DestructableDefinition('B003', 'ZTw0')
	..setName("Stone Wall (Dark)")
	..setVertexColorRed(50)
	..setVertexColorGreen(50)
	..setVertexColorBlue(50)


@compiletime function create_w3b_B004()
	new DestructableDefinition('B004', 'ZTw2')
	..setName("Stone Wall (Dark)")
	..setVertexColorRed(50)
	..setVertexColorGreen(50)
	..setVertexColorBlue(50)


// Original Table (contains all modified default/melee objects)
// These are emitted when createObjectDefinition uses the same base/new id.

@compiletime function create_w3b_CTtc()
	new DestructableDefinition('CTtc', 'CTtc')
	..setHitPoints(99999.0)
	..setPath("")
